title: Sunset Beach Marina

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: At Sunset Beach Marina in Morgantown, WV, on picturesque Cheat Lake, pontoon boat rentals are the perfect choice for a day of fun on the water. A pontoon boat offers a spacious and comfortable ride, ideal for leisurely cruising, fishing, or hosting a small party on the lake. With ample seating and a stable platform, pontoon boats are great for families and groups looking to relax and enjoy the scenic surroundings. Whether you want to explore the 13-mile-long Cheat Lake, anchor at a sandy beach, or try your hand at fishing, a pontoon boat rental from Sunset Beach Marina provides an exciting and memorable experience.
